appointmentDateTime.title: appointmentDateTime
appointmentDateTime.description: The exact date and time of the booked appointment. This is derived from the slot's date and start time. Display this output in a human-readable Date Time format (e.g., 2025-01-02 10:00 AM).

appointmentId.title: appointmentId
appointmentId.description: The unique identifier of the created appointment record. Display this as plain text to allow users to reference the appointment.

customerName.title: customerName
customerName.description: The customer’s full name as entered during the booking process. Display this to confirm the booking details.

email.title: email
email.description: The customer’s email address as provided during booking. Display this to confirm the booking details.

phone.title: phone
phone.description: The customer’s phone number as provided during booking. Display this to confirm the booking details.

slotName.title: slotName
slotName.description: The name of the booked slot as fetched from the system. Display this to confirm the booking details.

statusMessage.title: statusMessage
statusMessage.description: A message indicating the status of the booking operation (e.g., Booking Successful, Slot Not Available). Display this to inform the user of the outcome of their booking request.
